where: local, macOS, offline memory host (GCSP_OFFLINE=1, GCSP_REPOSITORY_MODE=memory)

steps.name: Open the presenter link: access key page usable
Type the key, Enter: workspace shows Your cars
Open Presenter controls: clock and controls ready
Tick on a fresh run
Account page (gcsp-account.html) load to Choose a replacement
Choose a replacement: setup form usable
Save choices: saved confirmation
Next release from the setup page
Continue: Released cars gallery with enabled Review buttons
Review this car: review page with countdown and Continue enabled
Reload: account offers Resume saved journey
Resume saved journey: back on the review page, usable
Continue to order review: summary with declarations
Submit order: outcome heading
Finish: account shows the order
Presenter page load (workspace and strip)
Reset to Main successful journey (confirm to settled strip)
Tick after the reset
Reset to Decline then change (confirm to settled strip)
Switch principal to Paula
Buddy activity load until the offer shows
Outbox load and open Paula's offer email
Offer link: offer page usable (Accept visible)
Decline this offer: reasons list loaded
Confirm decline (Body style): follow-up question shown
Confirm this change (Saloon): saved in a brief version
Tick from the offer page: the second offer is made
Outbox reload and open the new offer email
Second offer link: offer page usable
Accept this offer: accepted state
Warm reload of presenter
Warm reload of account
Warm reload of activity
Warm reload of offer
